note: Round 0's model is the base model plus the seed adapter, and the seed adapter is a no-op (lora_B is exactly zero, so B @ A == 0). This is therefore the untuned base model's greedy output under the run's prompt format -- the reference every later round is diffed against. Decoding is greedy, but it is not bit-portable: a different device or dtype can flip a near-tie argmax and change a few tokens. Re-record on the machine you will actually compare against; what the tripwire watches is round N against round N-1 on one machine, not this file against yours.
